tree.speaker: Marcus Green
tree.text: Hey, you're the new kid right? Name's Marcus. Welcome to Ravenside High!

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Thanks! What's this place like?

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: It's... mostly fine. But watch out for the Smile Club. They run things around here — and not in a good way.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Yeah. Who runs things around here?

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: Director Walsh is the principal. But Dylan Brooks? He acts like he owns the halls. And lately... people are afraid of him.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'm not here to make friends. Just point me to the cafeteria.

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: Alright then... It's down the main hall. Can't miss it.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I know something about the Smile Club. I saw the email Eli sent you informing you about them.

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: You want answers about that? First, I challenge you to a 1v1 basketball match. If you win, I'll tell you more. First to 5 wins!

tree.speaker: Marcus Green
tree.text: Oh hey — you must be Aiden's sister. I'm Marcus. He's already making a name for himself on the field.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'm Lena. What can you tell me about the school's network? Any interesting systems?

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: Network? I'm more of a ball-and-field guy. But Sophie Chen in the tech club — she'd know everything about that.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Nice to meet you. Any survival tips for the new girl?

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: Keep your head down, make the right friends, and don't attract the wrong attention. Especially from Dylan's crew.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Wanna play some 1v1 basketball?

children.speaker: Marcus Green
children.text: You're on! Let's see if you're as good as your brother.

tree.speaker: Sophie Chen
tree.text: You're Aiden, right? I heard you've been asking about the Smile Club. Be careful who hears you.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I think something's really wrong here. Can you help me figure it out?

children.speaker: Sophie Chen
children.text: Finally, someone who sees it. Come to the Computer Lab — I'll show you what I've been tracking. But we need to be discreet.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Never mind, forget I asked.

children.speaker: Sophie Chen
children.text: Suit yourself. But the truth doesn't stay hidden forever. When you're ready... I'll be in the lab.

tree.speaker: Sophie Chen
tree.text: Lena Parker? Word is you're decent with code. I could use someone like you.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'm good with more than code. What do you need?

children.speaker: Sophie Chen
children.text: The school's 'anti-bullying' system is a front. Director Walsh built it to monitor and control students. I need help cracking it.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Sounds dangerous. Count me out.

children.speaker: Sophie Chen
children.text: Dangerous is what they did to Mia Nakamura. Think about that.

tree.speaker: Dylan Brooks
tree.text: Well, well. The new kid. You've been making waves, Parker. I like that — or maybe I don't.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I know about the Smile Club, Dylan.

children.speaker: Dylan Brooks
children.text: Ha. You don't know anything. And if you're smart, you'll keep it that way. This is MY school.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'm just trying to fit in. No trouble here.

children.speaker: Dylan Brooks
children.text: Smart answer. Keep playing nice, and maybe you'll survive here. Smile, Parker.

tree.speaker: Mia Nakamura
tree.text: Oh... hi. Sorry, I didn't see you there. I was just... it doesn't matter.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Hey, are you okay? You seem upset.

children.speaker: Mia Nakamura
children.text: I... someone's been posting things about me online. Fake accounts. Horrible things. I don't know who it is.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Whatever. See you around.

children.speaker: Mia Nakamura
children.text: ... yeah. See you.

tree.speaker: Jake Morrison
tree.text: You're either brave or stupid coming up here, new kid. Rooftop's mine.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I heard you have proof about the Smile Club. I need it.

children.speaker: Jake Morrison
children.text: Maybe I do. Maybe I don't. Either way, I'm not giving it up for free. Bring me something the Smile Club doesn't want found, and we'll talk.

tree.speaker: Director Walsh
tree.text: Ah, Aiden Parker. Settling in well, I hope? Ravenside prides itself on being a welcoming environment.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I know about the Smile Club. I know you created it. It's over, Walsh.

children.speaker: Director Walsh
children.text: You have no idea what you're talking about. The Smile Club was designed to PROTECT students. Everything I do is for this school.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Yes sir, everything's great. Thank you.

children.speaker: Director Walsh
children.text: Good. Remember — at Ravenside, we smile. Always.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Why should I?

children.speaker: Oscar Jimenez
children.text:
Lose, and your reputation drops.
Win, and people respect you.

children.speaker: Oscar Jimenez
children.text: So... scared?

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Yes, accept the challenge

children.speaker: Aiden
children.text: Let’s do it.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: No, reject the challenge

children.speaker: Oscar Jimenez
children.text: Coward.

tree.speaker: Ava Thompson
tree.text: Oscar sent you? Then you heard enough to get curious, and maybe enough to get in trouble.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: What do you know about students meeting underneath the school?

children.speaker: Ava Thompson
children.text: Tomorrow, meet me in the Tech Lab. On Tuesday there are no people in that classroom. I have uncovered whispers about a secretive group orchestrating these underground meetings—they call themselves the Smile Club. But be very careful: do not tell anyone.

tree.speaker: Axel Knight
tree.text: Hold it right there. The rooftop is an exclusive VIP lounge for the POPULARS group. You need at least 60 Popular reputation to enter.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: [Check Reputation] I have enough reputation. Let me pass.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'll come back later.

tree.speaker: Ava Thompson
tree.text: You made it. Good. I've been monitoring the school's network traffic from these terminals.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: Did you find anything about the Smile Club?

children.speaker: Ava Thompson
children.text: They're encrypting everything. But Alan Chen claims to have actual hacked evidence against them. He is usually found in discreet places. Check your map to find him.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: [Give Hacked Credentials] Alan Chen gave me these hacked high school system credentials.

children.speaker: Ava Thompson
children.text: Great! What is the username and password for the admin terminal?

tree.speaker: Alan Chen
tree.text: You're looking for information on the Smile Club? I know things. But to give you the information, I need you to earn my trust. Get at least 70 Tech Club reputation, and not a word to anyone until then.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: [Check Reputation] I have 70 Tech Club reputation. Give me the information.

children.speaker: Player
children.text: I'll come back when I have more reputation.
